# Contribute {#contribute}

This wiki is meant to be added to. If you have a worked example, a
language-specific tip, or a correction, here is the whole process.

::: {.tada-key}
Copy the page template, write your page, add its filename to `_bookdown.yml`,
run `Rscript render.R`, and open a pull request. For a small fix, use the
**Edit this page** link in the footer of any chapter instead.
:::

## Make a page {#contribute-page}

1. **Copy the template.**

   ```bash
   cp templates/page-template.Rmd 12-my-page.Rmd
   ```

   [`templates/page-template.Rmd`](templates/page-template.Rmd) is a working
   example of everything this wiki uses: the callouts, the R/Python tabs, the
   before/after blocks, a checklist, and the house style. Write over it.

2. **Start with a level-1 heading and an ID**, because other pages link to it:

   ```markdown
   # My page {#my-page}
   ```

3. **Register the file** in `_bookdown.yml`, in the position you want it to
   appear. Keep `11-references.Rmd` last.

4. **Build and check.**

   ```bash
   Rscript render.R
   ```

   Open `docs/index.html`. If you cited anything, add it to
   `11-references.Rmd`, alphabetically by first author.

5. **Open a pull request** saying what you added and where it came from.

## The one rule {#contribute-rule}

::: {.tada-warn}
**Separate what the papers say from what you are adding.** Cite anything from a
source paper by author and year; label your own practical advice **wiki
guidance**, as this wiki does throughout. Keeping the two apart is what makes the
wiki trustworthy.
:::

## Templates {#contribute-templates}

Ready to copy, both for contributing and for your own projects.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [`templates/page-template.Rmd`](templates/page-template.Rmd) | Skeleton for a new wiki page |
| [`templates/README-template.md`](templates/README-template.md) | Project README covering every [Documented](#documented-readme) field |
| [`templates/tada-checklist.md`](templates/tada-checklist.md) | The full TADA checklist, to drop into a project |
| [`templates/code-review-checklist.md`](templates/code-review-checklist.md) | The four Rs, as a reviewer's worksheet |
